speaker: george_bryan
text: What had you before the play, Will? You looked across the act as if someone were at the gate.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ambrose Kettleby, from Somerset House. He is sent up for my lord's linen and his letters. My lord is with the court in Surrey.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Two things. That the house opened quietly, and when the new king is to be seen. My lord has a mind to see it, and says he will come unlooked-for. So Kettleby was to tell me he is coming. Thursday the second of October. He wrote it down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the comfit. The Lord Treasurer lies there very ill of the gout, and cannot stir hand nor foot, nor feed himself. Every paper in England which wants his hand is waiting on his foot.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Hear what he is not saying. An old man who cannot hold a pen, and two younger men waiting to hold it for him, and a play about a weak king and his favourites about to walk out onto a stage between them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item: we play it as licensed.
